head: 56f3db172de7f3e843a3ebf048f6f475ef700b40
title: fix(json): support os.PathLike serialization and guard dataclass class type in DefaultJSONProvider
expect: the maintainer doesn't want more types handled by the JSON provider, and a different error for invalid data isn't a bug worth catching; also against the project's LLM/AI policy
quote: I do not want to add more types to this. I do not care that the error on invalid data is different for some data, it's invalid regardless and would be fixed not caught.
